Paper Cups & PLA Cold Cup Options

Paper and PLA remain a separate packaging line. The latest supplied PDFs cover PET and injection PP products, so paper and PLA specifications require a separate current catalog or factory confirmation.

Key Features

  • Separate current paper/PLA catalog required
  • Confirm wall construction and coating by model
  • Request food-contact and end-of-life documents
  • Confirm lid and closure compatibility with samples
  • Do not assume compostability from PLA material alone
  • Confirm printing, MOQ and carton configuration per item

Quick Facts for Sourcing

  • • Order quantity: Confirm the minimum for your selected model and artwork.
  • • Documents: Request material and food-contact reports for your destination market.
  • • Fit: Confirm the cup, lid and sealing material with a physical sample.
  • • Specifications: Use the series table below as a starting point; request final drawings.

Do Not Infer Paper or PLA Specifications

The two latest supplied catalogs are for PET and injection PP cups. Paper and PLA capacity, wall construction, coating, compostability, printing, MOQ and compliance documents are not established by these PDFs and remain pending factory confirmation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are PLA cups compostable?

Compostability depends on the exact product, supporting test documentation and available local facilities. Request documents for the selected item and destination market.

What should I request for paper or PLA cups?

Ask for the exact material, coating, capacity, dimensions, carton quantity, food-contact documents, printing options and destination-market compliance documents.
